Name: Deadbeast
Information:
**Deadbeast**

Created from predatory animals to serve necromancers and their hoards. Deadbeasts are the results of many animals being cremated, their ashes becoming reanimated in the form of a dark, ferocious shadow of what it once was. Deadbeasts experience no hunger, exhaustion, or pain. They exist only to serve the masters who bound these poor souls together.

Stat Blocks.title: Deadbeast
languages: understands the languages of its creator but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Altered Form
traits.description: The deadbeast retains the appearance of its living counterpart when not in combat, maintaining an illusory form that requires a DC 12 Investigation check to see through. This allows it to act convincingly like its original counterpart. If the deadbeast uses its Death Roar, Death Smoke Pounce, or Body of Ash, this illusion vanishes until next time it completes a Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The deadbeast makes one Bite attack and one Rake attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 3 (1d4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Rake
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Death Smoke Pounce
actions.description: The deadbeast vanishes, turning into a deadly black smoke, and reappears in another unoccupied space within 30 feet that it chooses. It may then make one Bite attack, which deals an extra d12 of necrotic damage on a successful hit.

bonus_actions.name: Death Roar
bonus_actions.description: If the deadbeast uses its Multiattack and misses all its attacks, it may let out a furious roar that forces all creatures within 20 feet of it to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking a point of Combat Fatigue on a failure.

reactions.name: Body of Ash
reactions.description: When the deadbeast is hit by an attack it can see, it may turn its body momentarily into ash, causing the attack to pass through it harmlessly, and reducing all bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage it would have taken to be reduced to 0.
